A Guy With A Scarf research/Automated match video/Premium edition/FoloCam

Family or coach buys the device

FoloCamPremium

FoloCam LLC · United States (city not disclosed) · founded 2026 · active · folocam.com · last verified 2026-09-19

Family or coach buys the deviceGimbalEvidence AUnder €500 to start

FoloCam is an iOS app that pairs an iPhone 13 or newer with an Apple DockKit motorised gimbal and uses on-device AI to keep the ball in frame for soccer and basketball, recording 4K locally for $49.99 a year folocam-01, folocam-02.

For Parents and volunteer coaches who already own a recent iPhone and want a full-match recording that follows the ball for the price of a cheap gimbal and a low subscription, with no cloud account and no hardware lock-in folocam-01, folocam-03. It suits people who are comfortable with a one-developer product and will handle their own storage and sharing folocam-03.

FoloCam exists because Apple's DockKit framework and the Neural Engine in recent iPhones made it possible for a single developer, Gilbert Chen of Duplicacy and ActionStitch, to ship a ball-tracking camera as a $49.99 app, where the incumbents ship a $1,000 device folocam-03, folocam-05. It matters now because it sets the floor price for automated football filming at roughly $100 of gimbal plus $50 a year, with all processing on the phone and no video leaving the device, which is a privacy posture the cloud-based incumbents cannot match folocam-02, folocam-04. It tells you the capture layer is commoditising fast, that the value is moving to the platform and analysis layers, and that solo and small developers can now attack the low end of the market from the App Store folocam-05, folocam-06.

Price band App free for 10-minute recordings; $49.99/yr (€59.99/yr in Italy) for unlimited recording and RTMP; $150 Amazon kit with gimbal and lifetime subscription; DockKit gimbal from about $35 to $100 extra folocam-02

Italy The app is listed on the Italian App Store with the Premium Yearly in-app purchase at €59.99, and the gimbals it supports are sold through ordinary consumer retail folocam-07.

The verdict

Look if You film youth football or basketball with a phone already, you own or can buy a DockKit gimbal such as the Comitok Mogo, Insta360 Flow Pro or DJI Osmo Mobile 8, and you want a ball-following recording for under $200 all in folocam-01, folocam-02. You should also look if data privacy is a hard requirement, since nothing leaves the phone and the App Store label states no data is collected folocam-02, folocam-06.

Skip if You need cloud storage, sharing, highlights, analysis or a livestream product for parents, since FoloCam records to the Files app and its only distribution is a raw RTMP push folocam-02. You should also skip it if you need vendor continuity guarantees, since it is a solo-developer company with two App Store ratings in the US and none in Italy folocam-03, folocam-06, folocam-07.

Watch-outs

  • FoloCam is a one-person company, the developer states there are no investors and no plans to be acquired, and the roadmap depends on one person's time folocam-03.
  • The US App Store shows a 5.0 rating from only two ratings and the Italian listing has too few ratings to display, so there is no independent sentiment base yet folocam-06, folocam-07.
  • The lifetime subscription in the $150 Amazon kit is tied to the gimbal, so a broken or replaced gimbal raises the question of what happens to the licence folocam-08, folocam-09.
  • Users on the developer's forum report video freezes and slow tracking, gimbal motor noise and a loss of ball sight a couple of times per match in sample footage, and 4K60 is flagged by the developer as experimental and likely to slow tracking folocam-10, folocam-11, folocam-12.
  • DockKit gimbals need NFC pairing before the app can drive them, and the DJI Osmo Mobile 8P remote cannot be used at the same time as FoloCam folocam-12.
  • The current App Store build requires iOS 26 or later, which excludes older phones even where the site says iPhone 13 or newer folocam-06.

Products

  • FoloCam app (app). iOS app that drives a DockKit gimbal with on-device ball tracking for soccer and basketball, records 4K locally and offers RTMP output to paid users folocam-02.
  • FoloCam Kit (add-on). Amazon bundle of a 3-axis DockKit gimbal with a lifetime FoloCam subscription tied to the gimbal, $150 folocam-08.

Profile against the 24 criteria

Use-case fit
FoloCam is built for soccer and basketball, with more sports listed as coming soon and hockey mentioned by forum users folocam-01, folocam-11. It fits parents and volunteer coaches who want a single wide-to-medium recording that follows the ball, with no broadcast-style production, and the developer positions it against Veo and XbotGo on price folocam-05. It is a recording tool with no viewer product, so it is a poor fit for clubs that need to distribute matches to families folocam-02.
Capture quality
Recording is 4K30 on the iPhone camera at 2x zoom, with 4K60 experimental since version 1.4 in May 2026 folocam-02, folocam-10. The developer recommends iPhone 15 or newer for lossless 2x zoom on a full pitch, and a Soccer Pro mode is limited to iPhone 14 Pro, 15, 16 and 17 class devices folocam-02. Image quality is therefore the phone's own, which on a current iPhone exceeds most dedicated youth cameras in resolution, and the field of view is a single moving frame with no panoramic stitch folocam-01.
Automation accuracy
Tracking runs on the iPhone Neural Engine and the developer claims it can spot the ball near the far corner of a full field and follow it for most of a full-field match folocam-01, folocam-05. A forum user watching the developer's sample noted the system loses sight of the ball a couple of times, and another thread reports video freezes and slow tracking, so real-world consistency is still being tuned through frequent releases folocam-09, folocam-11. Basketball got a Pro mode and faster pan speed in versions 1.4 and 1.5 folocam-06, folocam-10.
Multi-angle and stitching
FoloCam drives one phone on one gimbal and produces a single recording with no multi-camera stitching folocam-01. The developer's separate ActionStitch product stitches two action cameras into a 180-degree panorama, which shows the capability exists in the same hands but is not part of FoloCam folocam-03.
Latency and live readiness
Live output is an RTMP push to a server URL and stream key, available only with the paid subscription folocam-02. There is no built-in viewer page, no adaptive bitrate statement and no published latency, so live readiness depends entirely on the destination platform and the venue's upload bandwidth folocam-02.
Reliability and resilience
All processing is local, so the recording continues without connectivity, and the app now warns on low storage folocam-02, folocam-06. Reliability issues reported by users are gimbal disconnections before NFC pairing, motor noise and occasional freezes in tracking folocam-11, folocam-12. Heat and battery behaviour over a 90-minute match at 4K with continuous inference is not documented and depends on the phone folocam-02.
Portability and install
The whole kit is a phone, a pocket gimbal and a tripod, which is the most portable setup in the category folocam-01. Setup requires NFC pairing of the DockKit gimbal, then mounting at a sideline position, and the developer recommends the cheaper Comitok Mogo over premium gimbals for this use folocam-12. Height and position guidance is limited to forum advice folocam-11.
Connectivity and bandwidth
No connectivity is needed to record, since tracking and video processing run on the phone and nothing is uploaded to FoloCam servers folocam-02. RTMP streaming needs whatever upload bandwidth the chosen bitrate demands, and no figures are published folocam-02. Files are stored in the iOS Files app under a FoloCam folder folocam-02.
Workflow and UX
The user pairs the gimbal, opens the app, chooses the sport and mode, and presses record, and the video lands in the Files app for manual sharing folocam-02. There is no cloud library, no team roster, no highlights and no clip tool, and users are asking on the forum for Apple Watch remote control, external microphone support and a live score overlay folocam-11. Version 1.5 added a watermark removal option folocam-06.
Analysis layer
There is no analysis layer, no tagging and no statistics folocam-02. Users can take the recorded file into any third-party analysis tool by hand folocam-02.
Integrations
The only integration is a generic RTMP output for paid users folocam-02. Hardware integration is through Apple DockKit with the Insta360 Flow Pro, Flow 2 Pro, DJI Osmo Mobile 8 and Comitok Mogo listed as compatible, and the DJI Osmo Mobile 8P works after NFC pairing with the caveat that its remote cannot run at the same time folocam-02, folocam-12.
Distribution and OTT
FoloCam has no distribution product, so families watch either through a third-party RTMP destination such as YouTube or through files shared manually after the match folocam-02. This keeps it firmly in the capture layer.
Data access and ownership
The user holds the only copy of the recording on their phone, since nothing is uploaded to FoloCam servers and the app collects no personal data folocam-02, folocam-06. There is no vendor licence over footage because the vendor never receives it folocam-02. Export is a plain file in the Files app folocam-02.
Privacy and compliance
The App Store privacy label states the developer does not collect any data from this app, and the support page says FoloCam collects no personal data and that all ball tracking and video processing runs on the iPhone folocam-02, folocam-06. For an EU club this removes the processor relationship entirely, leaving only the club's own obligations around filming minors folocam-02. No published GDPR statement, DPA or children's policy exists because none is needed for the app itself, though the RTMP destination will carry its own terms folocam-02.
Security
Recordings stay on the device and no account is created, which reduces the attack surface to the phone itself folocam-02. No security documentation is published. Not assessable further from public sources.
Pricing and TCO
The app is free for unlimited 10-minute recordings, $49.99 per year in the US and €59.99 per year in Italy for unlimited duration and RTMP, and there is no monthly plan folocam-02, folocam-06, folocam-07, folocam-13. The $150 Amazon kit bundles a gimbal with a lifetime subscription tied to that gimbal, and the developer has offered promo codes bringing a compatible gimbal to $35 folocam-05, folocam-08. A three-year total for a family is therefore about $100 for a gimbal plus $150 of subscription, or $150 once with the kit, against $1,000 and more for a dedicated camera with mandatory subscription folocam-02, folocam-08.
Support and service
Support is the developer answering on the FoloCam user community forum and the ActionStitch forum, and the about page states he personally replies to almost every question folocam-03, folocam-11. Threads from September 2026 show replies within a day folocam-12. There is no phone support, SLA or reseller network.
Company health and roadmap
FoloCam LLC is an independent US company run solely by Gilbert Chen, who states there are no investors, no growth headcount and no plans to be acquired, and that the roadmap follows user requests and Apple silicon capabilities folocam-03. The app launched in March 2026 and has shipped versions 1.3, 1.4 and 1.5 between then and June 2026, adding Basketball Pro, 4K60 and watermark removal folocam-05, folocam-06, folocam-10. Financials are not public and the company's continuity rests on one person folocam-03.
Evidence and references
Primary evidence comes from the FoloCam site, support page, about page and App Store listings in the US and Italy folocam-01, folocam-02, folocam-03, folocam-06, folocam-07. User sentiment comes from the developer-run forums, where the developer moderates, and from the ActionStitch forum announcements folocam-05, folocam-09, folocam-11. No independent review or test was found, and the Junior Grassroots Hub partner page referenced in search results returned a 404 folocam-14.
Coach and analyst satisfaction
Forum users are enthusiastic about price and simplicity and are actively requesting features such as motion profiles, individual player tracking, higher frame rates and live scores, which signals a small base of engaged early adopters folocam-11. Complaints concentrate on tracking freezes, gimbal noise and DJI compatibility folocam-11, folocam-12. There are two US App Store ratings, both five stars folocam-06.
Edge versus cloud
FoloCam is entirely edge, with detection, gimbal control and encoding on the iPhone and no cloud component at all folocam-02. The trade-off is that features which need heavy compute, such as multi-angle stitching or event detection, are constrained by the phone and the developer flags 4K60 as slowing tracking folocam-10.
Accessibility and languages
The app is in English and Simplified Chinese, requires iOS 26 or later, and is distributed through App Stores worldwide including Italy folocam-06, folocam-07. There is no Android version and users have asked for one folocam-11.
Upgrade path
Upgrades arrive as app releases and as new iPhones, since tracking quality scales with the phone's Neural Engine, and the developer explicitly ties the roadmap to Apple silicon folocam-03. There is no path into a platform or analysis product from the same vendor, so a club that outgrows it changes vendor folocam-02.
Differentiators worth testing
Test full-pitch tracking on an 11-a-side game from the halfway line with an iPhone 15 or newer at 2x, since that is the developer's headline claim folocam-01, folocam-02. Test a 90-minute recording for heat throttling and battery on the phone model your coaches carry, since no vendor data exists folocam-02. Test the Comitok Mogo against the Insta360 Flow Pro for motor noise and pan speed on basketball, where users report differences folocam-11, folocam-12.

Company

Ownership and funding FoloCam LLC is an independent US software company owned and run by its sole developer Gilbert Chen, author of the Duplicacy backup tool and the ActionStitch panorama app, with no outside investors by his own statement folocam-03.

Financials not public

Scale, company-stated Two ratings at 5.0 on the US App Store and too few to display in Italy as of 19 September 2026 folocam-06, folocam-07. App version 1.5 released 19 June 2026 folocam-06. The FoloCam user forum shows threads with up to 11 replies as of September 2026 folocam-11.
